thread:
Nina: Night triage check-in — volume spike: 47 new tickets since 23:00, 14 high-priority. Not sure how many are dupes. Known issues: 502s on hosted API between 00:10–00:45, and an embeddings latency regression causing timeouts. Can folks claim ownership? Suggested: triage dupes first, escalate >P1. @Sam @Jess

Sam: I can take the P0/P1s for payments + routing. I'll start with the 502s and check upstream timeouts. Observed surge from eu-west-1 starting ~00:12. Will post any logs here.

Jess: FYI we rolled a routing tweak yesterday that touched the cache fallback path — could be related. @Ravi can you confirm whether the fallback binary was included in the canary? Also saw embedding batch job OOM at ~00:22, ticket #3842 created. :thinking_face:

Ravi: I'll pull the canary diff and grep the rollout logs. Will also update the 'escalate-p1' macro to include on-call for tonight and a canned customer reply. Draft macro below, will push shortly:

```/macro escalate-p1-night
summary: P1 incident - immediate attention
steps:
 - ping: @oncall
 - notify: eng-oncall, eng-runtime
 - run: /run rollback-routing
 - attach: last-5-error-logs
```

SupportBot: ALERT: Rate limit surge detected for hosted-api (tokens/sec) — auto-scaling triggered at 00:18; scaled +2 instances.

Maria: I'll take backlog triage and mark dupes. If anyone wants pairing for repros, ping me. Also suggest we add a short canned reply for customers about embedding slowness.

Sam: Quick update — 502s look like transient nginx upstream timeouts due to shorter keepalive on the new proxy. Increasing keepalive to 65s in eu-west-1 reduced error rate in canary. Pushing canary now and monitoring. :thumbsup:

Ravi: Macro updated and saved as "escalate-p1-night". Added canned reply for embeddings:

```We are aware of increased latency for embeddings in certain regions and are actively investigating. If you can share request IDs and timestamps, that will help us debug faster.```

Jess: Thanks team — P0 handed to Sam (routing), Maria will own backlog/dupes, I'll follow up tomorrow with a short postmortem and suggested mitigations (routing rollback + cache sanity checks). :white_check_mark:

Nina: Perfect — please add any links to diagnostic dashboards here and set the escalate macro to notify oncall once pushed. I'll run handoff notes at 07:00. Thanks! :coffee:
